headline: Philippine Stock Exchange Profits Rise in Nine-Month Period on Revenue Growth
summary: Higher operating revenues boosted nine-month net income for the Philippine Stock Exchange Inc. ending September.
why: The Philippine Stock Exchange (PSE) operates the sole equity exchange market in the Philippines.

impacts.name: Philippine Stock Exchange
impacts.why: Higher 9M operating revenues led to increased earnings for the exchange operator.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h
